findings: The served client and model are now static template literals. The only interpolation is JSON.stringify of the static FACTS.layers, so no request-derived data reaches the served JS and there is no injection path.
The one nested template literal in src/take-apart-client.js (line 144) is correctly escaped. The literals contain no other backslashes or `${`, so the served code keeps its previous behavior.
The change adds no routes, dependencies, headers or secrets. The .gitignore change only un-ignores evidence/take-apart-bundling/*.log.

scripts/capture-take-apart.mjs binds only to 127.0.0.1 and starts wrangler with an argument array, so no shell is involved. It removes its temp build directory afterwards. WRANGLER_BIN, PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE and CHROME_BIN come from the operator's environment. Chrome runs with --no-sandbox, which is acceptable on the CI runner only.
Non-blocking: the served JS routes have no CSP or nosniff headers. That is unchanged from before this work order. The review is saved at runs/wo-gh-11/reviewer-security.output.md.
